race.comment: MISS TORONADO (7) earns top billing after a decisive first-up win at St Arnaud, where she was near the top of an open market and put just over two lengths on Asawin. This is a harder assignment from that country meeting, but she put them away with ease first-up and looks ready to go on with the job now. BELLA CINQUE (4) is the proven track-and-distance mare, with one win and three placings from six attempts, and her latest second to ILOVEDIAMONDS at this track was solid enough despite racing keenly. Has the speed to get across and the claim of Daniels helps. TRIPLE SALUTE (3) resumes after five months and will be fitter for a Mornington jumpout, with his one previous start at this venue producing a placing. Can mae an impression first-up. ILOVEDIAMONDS (1) has won three in a row, holding on to score at this track and trip 9 days ago. Drawn wider now, but her recent form is hard to knock. Can win again without surprising. PODARGONI (8) is next.
